releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.202: Check for Updates now offers the newer native build containing Home Screen widget resizing Left–Right and Upper–Neeche. The widget adapts its layout to the available width and height. Four independent shortcuts and individual 3D press feedback are preserved.
